Taskbar_Description: Built-in taskbar appearance; no separate TranslucentTB installation. Runs when enabled and restores Windows appearance when turned off.
Taskbar_EnabledHint: Off by default. Disabling restores Windows appearance after this plugin has taken control.
Taskbar_ExecutablePathHint: Leave empty to use the built-in component. Select a program only to use your own portable copy.
Taskbar_StyleHint: Effects depend on Windows and TranslucentTB versions. Save to see the actual taskbar change.
Taskbar_OpacityHint: 0 is fully transparent; 100 is opaque. Valid range: 0–100.
Taskbar_UseChineseHint: Uses the official Chinese translation. Some engine menus may require restarting TranslucentTB.
Taskbar_NotInstalled: The built-in component is unavailable. Reinstall the complete Lertaro package.
Taskbar_InvalidExecutable: Select an existing TranslucentTB.exe using its full path.
Taskbar_EngineConflict: A different TranslucentTB copy is running. Close it before changing engines.
Taskbar_ApplyFailed: Could not apply taskbar appearance. Check the TranslucentTB program, color, opacity, rules and configuration file permissions. Invalid existing configuration is left unchanged.
Taskbar_BundleMissing: The taskbar component is missing or does not match this build. Reinstall the complete Lertaro package.
Taskbar_Windows11Required: The built-in taskbar component currently requires Windows 11. On Windows 10, select a compatible external program.
Taskbar_DependenciesFailed: Could not prepare the taskbar runtime. Try again later, or contact your administrator if system policy blocks framework installation.
Taskbar_PreviewBuiltInOnly: Live preview supports the built-in component only. Save settings to apply to an external program.
